character: Lively resort village at 1,200m in the Aravis massif. Beautiful traditional church and square. 220km ski area. Lively apres, ice rink, swimming, restaurants. Excellent for families. Aravis cheese producers.
activities_nearby: 220km Aravis ski area. Ice rink. Swimming. Paragliding. Via ferrata. Snowshoeing. Torch-lit descents. Aravis cheese market.
